user.title: SwitchBot Universal Remote
user.description: Enter the remote's BLE address and its communication key.

cloud_setup.title: Connect SwitchBot cloud?
cloud_setup.description: Cloud access is optional, but it provides names and cloud-only IR/HID remotes. You can also configure it later.

cloud_connect.title: SwitchBot cloud account
cloud_connect.description: Sign in with the same email and password you use in the SwitchBot app. Home Assistant stores only renewable tokens; your password is never saved.

cloud_home.title: Choose a SwitchBot home
cloud_home.description: This account has more than one home. Select the home that contains this Universal Remote.

error.key_length: Key must be 16 bytes (32 hex characters).
error.key_id_hex: Key ID must be valid hexadecimal.
error.key_id_range: Key ID must fit in one byte (00-FF).
error.cloud_auth_failed: Sign-in failed. Check the email and password. Accounts that use Google, Apple, or Amazon sign-in are not supported by password login yet.
error.cloud_no_homes: Sign-in succeeded, but no SwitchBot homes were returned.
error.cloud_home_failed: The selected home could not be validated.

menu_options.refresh_all_remotes: Refresh all remotes from device + cloud

quick_bind.title: Quick bind
quick_bind.description: Choose a logical WoRWS remote and a Home Assistant light. A complete default mapping will be generated; it can be edited later without rewriting the physical remote.

edit_mappings.title: Edit mappings
edit_mappings.description: Select a saved whole-remote binding. Changes affect Home Assistant actions only and do not rewrite the WoRWS remote.

mapping_menu.title: Edit {remote}
mapping_menu.description: Edit the generated light preset or assign any Home Assistant action to one exact physical button.

edit_mapping.title: Edit mappings for {remote}
edit_mapping.description: Choose an action for every physical button group. Changes take effect immediately and remain linked by stable remote ID, even if the remote moves to another slot.

edit_button_action.title: Choose a button on {remote}
edit_button_action.description: Buttons are identified by their screen page and physical key index, so mappings remain distinct across multi-page remotes.

configure_button_action.title: Action for {button}
configure_button_action.description: Remote: {remote}. Build any Home Assistant action sequence below. An empty sequence disables this button. Enable ‘Use Quick-bind default’ to remove the override and inherit the light preset again. No automation entity is created.

remote_manager.title: Remote manager
remote_manager.description:
This is the merged live list from the Universal Remote and SwitchBot cloud. Choose whether you want to add a new remote or work with an existing one. Slots are detected and maintained automatically.

{remotes}

data.action: What do you want to do?

manage_existing_remote.title: Edit / recreate remote
manage_existing_remote.description:
Select an existing remote. Its current physical slot is detected automatically.

{remotes}

recreate_remote.title: Recreate remote
recreate_remote.description: Edit the information below, then recreate {remote} ({kind}) in a newly detected slot. The existing entry is removed first.

data.name: Name shown on the remote
data.target_key: Target AES key (same as add-on device_key)

edit_remote.title: Rename remote
edit_remote.description: Rename {remote} on the Universal Remote and, for a cloud IR remote, in SwitchBot cloud too.

delete_managed_remote.title: Delete remote
delete_managed_remote.description: Delete {remote} from the Universal Remote and remove its matching cloud record when applicable?

cloud_account.title: SwitchBot cloud account
cloud_account.description: Sign in with the same email and password you use in the SwitchBot app. Home Assistant stores only renewable tokens and refreshes them automatically; your password is never saved.

cloud_account_home.title: Choose a SwitchBot home
cloud_account_home.description: This account has more than one home. Select the home that contains this Universal Remote.

update_credentials.title: Update WoRWS communication key
update_credentials.description: Update the rotating communication key and key ID used to encrypt commands sent to the Universal Remote. This is not the add-on target key. The integration reloads after saving.

bind_native.title: Add native remote
bind_native.description: Choose a native device template for the fake hub. Every native remote can be edited later: templates only provide the initial pages and buttons. Each native tile requires its own live bridge MAC; slots and stable IDs are managed automatically. Current stage/result: {status}

data.name: Name shown on the remote
data.target_key: Target AES key (same as add-on device_key)

custom_native_builder.title: Remote layout
custom_native_builder.description: Create or edit the complete Main/A/B/C/D layout. Standard device types are templates, not locked profiles. Technical slots and IDs are managed automatically. Page names are stored in Home Assistant; the WoRWS screen uses its native A-D icons.

data.name: Remote name
data.target_key: Target AES key (same as add-on device_key)
data.page_1_name: Page A name in Home Assistant
data.page_2_name: Page B name in Home Assistant
data.page_3_name: Page C name in Home Assistant
data.page_4_name: Page D name in Home Assistant

custom_native_main.title: Remote layout — Main page
custom_native_main.description: Assign a function to each physical position. A-D positions with enabled pages are reserved for their page links: {page_links}.

custom_native_page.title: Remote layout — Page {page}
custom_native_page.description: Choose up to 18 categorized actions for page {page} ({name}). WoRWS displays its matching built-in icon; Home Assistant receives the page, button index, function, friendly name and MDI icon.

custom_native_review.title: Review remote layout
custom_native_review.description:
Review the editable layout before writing it to the Universal Remote. The integration preserves the stable remote ID and Home Assistant button mappings when an existing remote is updated.

{layout}

menu_options.ir_saved_cloud: Install a remote saved in SwitchBot cloud
menu_options.ir_catalog_type: Add from the SwitchBot IR catalog

ir_saved_cloud.title: Install a saved cloud IR remote
ir_saved_cloud.description: Downloads the complete code bank and button map saved by the official app, then selects the WoRWS slot automatically. Current stage/result: {status}

data.name: Name shown on the remote
data.replace_existing: Replace the matching remote if already installed

ir_catalog_type.title: SwitchBot IR catalog
ir_catalog_type.description: Choose an appliance type. The catalog metadata is local; the selected code bank is downloaded from your SwitchBot account.

ir_catalog_model.title: Choose an IR model
ir_catalog_model.description: The integration downloads this model exactly as the official app does, installs it locally, and saves/binds it to your SwitchBot cloud account. Current stage/result: {status}

data.name: Name shown on the remote
data.replace_existing: Replace the matching remote if already installed

ir_captured.title: Captured IR fallback
ir_captured.description: Installs the known-good code bank recovered from the trace. This path works without cloud access. Current stage/result: {status}

data.name: Name shown on the remote
data.replace_existing: Replace this IR profile if it is already installed

native_diagnostics.title: Native diagnostics
native_diagnostics.description: Runs the read-only 0F 63 query set against the Universal Remote. It can take about 30 seconds. Copy the results shown here after it finishes. Current results: {results}

test_native_bridge.title: Test native bridge connectivity
test_native_bridge.description: Checks that the saved fake-target MAC is advertising and can be observed through Home Assistant's other Bluetooth adapter. The bridge's firmware-specific raw ATT path is verified by an actual WoRWS button press. Current result: {status}

add_remote.title: Add an HID remote
add_remote.description: The physical slot is selected automatically. UniversalBLE needs a prior HID pair.

pair_host.title: HID-pair to a host
pair_host.description: Tell the remote to pair as a BLE keyboard to this host MAC. The host must accept the pairing (Linux/BlueZ).

diagnostics_menu.title: Diagnostics and maintenance
diagnostics_menu.description: Checks that are only needed when something is wrong, or when setting up an HID remote.

error.key_length: Key must be 16 bytes (32 hex characters).
error.key_id_hex: Key ID must be valid hexadecimal.
error.key_id_range: Key ID must fit in one byte (00-FF).
error.not_connected: Not connected to the remote over Bluetooth.
error.resp_hid_no_pair: Remote is not HID-paired to a host yet (0x11). Pair it first.
error.resp_unknown: Device returned an unexpected error code.
error.target_key_id_hex: Target key ID must be hexadecimal.
error.target_key_id_range: Target key ID must fit in one byte (00-FF).
error.target_key_hex: Target key must be valid hexadecimal.
error.target_key_length: Target key must be 16 bytes (32 hexadecimal characters).
error.native_table_timeout: The Universal Remote device table could not be read.
error.device_id_invalid: Enter exactly six hexadecimal MAC bytes.
error.native_target_mac_in_use: This target MAC already belongs to a native tile. WoRWS requires a different live BLE MAC for every additional native tile.
error.communication_key_invalid: An encrypted reply arrived but could not be decoded. The WoRWS communication key/key ID is stale or incorrect; update it and retry.
error.native_set_key_timeout: The remote did not answer the target-key command (set_key timeout).
error.native_set_key_rejected: The remote rejected the target-key command. The response code is shown above.
error.native_associate_timeout: The remote did not answer the target association command (associate timeout).
error.native_associate_rejected: The remote rejected the target association command. The response code is shown above.
error.native_bind_timeout: The remote did not answer the native page command (bind timeout).
error.native_bind_main_timeout: The remote did not answer the native main-page command (bind_main timeout).
error.native_bind_page_1_timeout: The remote did not answer the native Page A command.
error.native_bind_page_2_timeout: The remote did not answer the native Page B command.
error.native_bind_page_3_timeout: The remote did not answer the native Page C command.
error.native_bind_page_4_timeout: The remote did not answer the native Page D command.
error.native_bind_colors_timeout: The remote did not answer the native colour-page command (bind_colors timeout).
error.native_bind_rejected: The remote rejected the native page command. The response code is shown above.
error.native_transport_error: BLE transport failed. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.native_handshake_timeout: The secure session could not be established. The delete command was not sent. Check that the dedicated bridge adapter is excluded from WoRWS management routes.
error.native_bridge_not_paused: The add-on did not acknowledge the pause request, so the remote is still bonded to the fake device and the secure session could not start. Make sure the SwitchBot URC Bridge add-on is running the matching version and connected to MQTT, then retry.
error.too_many_custom_buttons: A submenu can contain at most 18 buttons.
error.empty_custom_page: Select at least one action, or go back and disable this page.
error.bridge_not_configured: No saved native bridge target is available. Bind it once first.
error.bridge_not_found: The bridge adapter was not observed by a direct scan on hci0. Check its advertising, adapter assignment, and radio range.
error.bridge_test_failed: Could not complete the GATT/crypto bridge test. The exact error is shown above and logged.
error.bridge_test_rejected: The bridge connected but did not acknowledge the encrypted test command.
error.ir_profile_invalid: The selected IR profile is invalid.
error.ir_table_timeout: The Universal Remote device table could not be read.
error.ir_duplicate_requires_replace: This IR profile is already installed. Enable replacement to reinstall it.
error.ir_delete_failed: The existing IR profile could not be removed.
error.ir_install_timeout: The Universal Remote did not answer an IR installation stage after three retries. The current stage is shown above.
error.ir_install_rejected: The Universal Remote rejected an IR installation stage. The current stage and response are shown above.
error.ir_transport_error: IR installation failed at the BLE transport layer. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.ir_cloud_download_failed: The SwitchBot cloud did not return a usable IR code bank, or saving the new cloud record failed. Check the log and account region.
error.inventory_refresh_failed: Could not read the current remote list from the Universal Remote.
error.remote_required: Select a remote for this action.
error.rename_failed: The Universal Remote rejected the rename command.
error.delete_failed: The Universal Remote rejected the delete command.
error.remote_operation_failed: The remote operation failed. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.recreate_credentials_missing: This native remote cannot be recreated because its saved bridge credentials are unavailable. Add it again through Add remote instead.
error.recreate_profile_missing: This remote cannot be recreated because its complete local or cloud profile is unavailable.
error.recreate_not_supported: Recreation is not supported for this remote type.
error.cloud_auth_failed: Sign-in failed. Check the email and password. Accounts that use Google, Apple, or Amazon sign-in are not supported by password login yet.
error.cloud_no_homes: Sign-in succeeded, but no SwitchBot homes were returned.
error.cloud_home_failed: The selected home could not be validated.
error.cloud_update_failed: The local change succeeded, but the SwitchBot cloud update failed. Refresh the list before retrying.
error.invalid_actions: Home Assistant could not validate this action sequence.

abort.no_bindable_remotes: No locally managed remote with a stable ID is available. Recreate or add a native remote first.
abort.no_bindings: No remote bindings have been created yet. Use Quick bind first.
abort.button_list_unavailable: This remote does not have a locally known native button layout, so individual button actions cannot be edited yet.
abort.cloud_not_configured: Connect a SwitchBot cloud account first.
abort.cloud_no_ir_remotes: No saved IR remotes were found in this SwitchBot account.
abort.catalog_empty: The selected catalog section is empty.
abort.remote_not_on_device: That remote exists only in the cloud and cannot be renamed on the device.
abort.inventory_unavailable: The current physical remote list could not be read, so no change was made.
